answer_1.quote: We validate the proposed gating mechanisms on three popular translation tasks: IWSLT14 German to English (DE-EN), IWSLT15 English to Vietnamese (EN-VI), and Multi30K DE-EN.

answer_2.quote: For quantifying the level of model calibration, we report Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Maximum Calibration Error (MCE). ... We also report popular translation evaluation metrics: BLEU, METEOR, WER, ROUGE-L, and NIST.
